speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the specific nature of your double vision, and tell me if your upper limb weakness and difficulty climbing stairs are symmetrical or one-sided.

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The double vision worsening with gaze (up/down) and the fatigable weakness that improves with rest are classic presentations of neuromuscular junction disorders, specifically Myasthenia Gravis.
